irregularities.item: Generic league-wide total rungs in v3 books
irregularities.detail: Many v3 total selections repeat identical lines/probabilities across fixtures in a league (e.g. every NHL game Over 5.5 at 70.1%). These are model rungs, not fixture-specific verified facts; none is promoted on this desk and they must not be read as per-match research.
>70% probability mathematically implies a fair US price shorter than about -234, so the +10000 upper end of the brief band can never contain a >70% pick. The effective strict band is -250..-234.
